metrics.name: Consumables Below 20%
metrics.gotcha: Consumables[] confirmed fields: prtMarkerSuppliesMarkerIndex, prtMarkerSuppliesColorantIndex, prtMarkerSuppliesClass, prtMarkerSuppliesType (string e.g. 'Toner'), prtMarkerSuppliesDescription (string e.g. 'Black Cartridge HP W2020X'), prtMarkerSuppliesSupplyUnit (string 'Percent'), prtMarkerSuppliesMaxCapacity (integer 100), prtMarkerSuppliesLevel (integer), prtMarkerSuppliesPercentageRemaining_r (INTEGER 0-100 — Liongard computed). Use prtMarkerSuppliesPercentageRemaining_r for numeric comparison.

metrics.name: Lifetime Impression Count
metrics.gotcha: prtMarkerLifeCount also appears nested in SystemInfo.prtMarkerDetails.prtMarkerLifeCount — both paths return the same value. Use prtMarkerTable[0].prtMarkerLifeCount (the direct SNMP MIB path). Validated value: 13529.

metrics.name: Network Interface IP
metrics.gotcha: SystemInfo.ipAddress can be '127.0.0.1' (loopback — the SNMP management address Liongard used to connect). The real device IP is in ifTable[].ipAdEntAddr. Filter != '127.0.0.1' to get the actual network interface address. Validated: returned '192.168.128.190'.

metrics.name: Printer Name (sysName)
metrics.gotcha: SystemInfo confirmed fields: sysDesc (string), sysObjectID (string), sysUpTime (string), sysContact (string), sysName (string), sysLocation (string), snmpOutTraps (integer), sysServices (integer), ifNumber (integer), vendor (string), printerSerialNumber (string), ipAddress (string), prtMarkerDetails (object). NOTE: SystemInfo.ipAddress may be '127.0.0.1' (loopback) — use ifTable path for real management IP.
